verdict.rationale: PostHog's product-analytics docs explicitly say you can build insights, save them to dashboards, and share them (posthog-docs-3, posthog-docs-25). Dashboards are also a first-class object exposed through 18 MCP tools and created by PostHog AI and the wizard. However, the documentation is only summary-level. Missing for 10: detailed docs on sharing mechanics (team permissions, share links or embeds), depth on dashboard composition and layout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
